title: THE SCORE MULTIPLIER ON SCREEN, FOG OF WAR PAYS
why: his order of 10-28, that the multiplier should be indicated to the player, and his addition that fog of war is a multiplier row (the host's in a party): a score row in Settings under difficulty, a small x tag beside the score label in a raid, and one settings line on the extracted card and the demo run over card; nothing at x1.00
now: fog of war on pays 5 percent more sp; the settings score multiplier shows in settings, beside the score in a raid and once on the end card
